name: FilesToRename
label: File(s) to rename
description: The path(s) of the file(s) to rename. Supports wildcards like *.txt.

name: RenameScheme
label: Rename scheme
description: Specifies the rename scheme to apply.

selectOptions.label: Set new name
selectOptions.description: Sets a completely new name for the file.

selectOptions.label: Add text
selectOptions.description: Adds text to the existing file name.

selectOptions.label: Remove text
selectOptions.description: Removes specified text from the file name.

selectOptions.label: Replace text
selectOptions.description: Replaces specified text in the file name.

selectOptions.label: Add datetime
selectOptions.description: Appends a timestamp to the file name.

selectOptions.label: Make sequential
selectOptions.description: Renames the file with a sequential number.

name: NewFileName
label: New file name
description: The new name for the file(s). Required for some rename schemes.

name: KeepExtension
label: Keep extension
description: Indicates whether to keep the original file extension.

name: IfExistsAction
label: If file exists
description: Specifies the behavior when a file already exists in the destination folder.

selectOptions.label: Do nothing
selectOptions.description: Skips the file if it already exists.

selectOptions.label: Overwrite
selectOptions.description: Deletes the existing file and moves the new file.

name: RenamedFiles
label: Renamed Files
description: Returns the list of successfully renamed files.
